observations: One behaviour change of round 3 I graded an observation rather than a failure, named precisely so the reviewer may re-grade it. A block comment whose CLOSING line starts with `//` — `/*`, then the text, then `// */` — is no longer credited, because the `//` branch now wins before the `*/` branch and the line is consumed as a line comment, leaving the block's interior unread. Such a tree is refused with `the comment above DISPATCH_BODY_MAX (…) does not name maxInputChars`, naming the site and what to write. It is fail-closed, the shape is one neither gofmt nor Biome produces, and the remedy is to put `*/` on its own line; the alternative grade would send the issue back for a tree nobody writes while the gate's own direction — never report agreement it has not established — is intact. For completeness: a closer followed by a line comment on the same line (`*/ // note`) is refused too, and that one is not this round's doing — it was refused at round 2's head as well.

The walk's remaining transparency is bounded, re-checked this round: a `const (` opener is skipped, so a Go doc comment on a one-member group reaches its member, but any previous member of the group ends the walk, which is what keeps the real `embed.go` honest; the pairing moved to a preceding member's comment is still refused.

Unchanged and still out of scope, as every round: an ask's embedded text is `question || ' ' || coalesce(answer->>'text','')` and a document's markdown is cut at the same limit with the same silence (dispatch://INFRA-114 owns both); the generated copies of the cap are held by `bun run check:go` in a job main's ruleset does not require.
